explanation: Artists avoiding the First World War gathered in neutral Switzerland. Their anarchic performances mocked the logic they blamed for the war, and Dada soon spread to Berlin and Paris.

claims.text: The Dada movement began in 1916 at the Cabaret Voltaire in Zurich.
Dada did not begin in Paris, Berlin or Vienna.
Many early Dada artists had come to neutral Switzerland to avoid the First World War.
Dada performances mocked the reason and logic that the artists blamed for the war.
Dada spread to cities including Berlin and Paris.
